name: BigCommerce
label: BigCommerce Management API — Catalog v3, Orders v2, Webhooks v3
description: BigCommerce REST: Catalog v3, Orders v2, Customers v3. Header X-Auth-Token. Path includes store_hash. product_create requires name, type, weight, price (https://developer.bigcommerce.com/docs/rest-catalog/products#create-a-product). order_update takes status_id, staff_notes, billing_address, … Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: product_list | product_get | product_create | order_list | order_get | order_update | customer_get | trigger. trigger (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: product_create.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Order id for order_get / order_update path {id}. Example: 100.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size for product_list, order_list, customer_get. Example: 50.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Page number for product_list, order_list, customer_get. Example: 1.

schema.label: product_id
schema.description: product_get path {product_id}. Example: 77.

schema.label: status_id
schema.description: order_list query filter and order_update body status id. Example: 11 (Awaiting Fulfillment).

schema.label: id:in
schema.description: customer_get query `id:in` (comma-separated customer ids).

schema.label: name
schema.description: product_create required unique product name. product_list query filter. Example: Studio mug.

schema.label: type
schema.description: product_create required type. EXACT: physical | digital. Example: physical.

schema.label: weight
schema.description: product_create required weight in the store's unit. Example: 4.

schema.label: price
schema.description: product_create required price (tax included or excluded per store settings). Example: 10.

schema.label: sku
schema.description: product_create SKU (unique). product_list query filter. Example: MUG-001.

schema.label: description
schema.description: product_create HTML description.

schema.label: categories
schema.description: product_create category id array. Required when Catalog V2 product experience is enabled. Example: [23,21].

schema.label: brand_id
schema.description: product_create existing brand id. Alternative to brand_name.

schema.label: brand_name
schema.description: product_create brand name (created if missing). Alternative to brand_id.

schema.label: inventory_level
schema.description: product_create current inventory (when inventory_tracking is on). Example: 50.

schema.label: sale_price
schema.description: product_create sale price override.

schema.label: cost_price
schema.description: product_create cost price (not displayed).

schema.label: retail_price
schema.description: product_create retail/MSRP shown on the product page.

schema.label: is_visible
schema.description: product_create visibility. product_list query filter. Example: true.

schema.label: staff_notes
schema.description: order_update staff-only notes.

schema.label: customer_message
schema.description: order_update customer-facing message / order comment.

schema.label: customer_id
schema.description: order_update customer id. Example: 1.

schema.label: payment_method
schema.description: order_update payment method label. Example: Manual.

schema.label: billing_address
schema.description: order_update billing address {first_name,last_name,street_1,city,state,zip,country,country_iso2}.

schema.label: shipping_addresses
schema.description: order_update shipping address objects.

schema.label: is_deleted
schema.description: order_update archive flag. true archives the order.

schema.label: email:in
schema.description: customer_get query `email:in` (comma-separated emails). Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: include
schema.description: customer_get query `include`. Example: addresses,storecredit.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: product_list | product_get | product_create | order_list | order_get | order_update | customer_get | trigger. Selecting trigger (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type header. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Store Hash
configurationParameters.description: Store hash from the control panel.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
